profile.headline: Software Engineer 👨🏻‍💻
profile.summary:
Fullstack engineer with a background that revolves around business administration, with an emphasis in finance. I am a self-motivated, hard working, result-driven individual.

Tech Stack:
Front-End: JavaScript (ES5/ES6+), React, Styled Components, Bootstrap, jQuery, HTML, CSS
Back-End: Node, Express, Sequelize, Mongoose, Postgres, MongoDB, MySQL, Cassandra
Other: AWS (EC2, S3), git, Webpack, Babel, New Relic, K6, Mocha, Chai, SQL, NoSQL

positions.title: Financial Analyst
positions.description:
• Prepared Financial and Operational Forecasts, Reports and Analyses
• Created 3-Year, Annual, and Quarterly Business Plans/Forecasts/Flashes
• Automated day to day reports with excel VBA

positions.title: Purchasing Coordinator
positions.description:
• Performed cost analysis research by community and floor plans
• Researched, reported, and fixed budget discrepancies
• Created community cost forecasts by floor plans and vendors

positions.title: Purchasing Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted in company-wide implementation of new cloud based contract management software
• Communicated current and future spending data to upper management
• Performed vendor vetting, maintenance, and system onboarding
